---
name: Asset or research suggestion
about: Suggest an independently reusable frontend material or a source worth studying
title: "[Asset] "
---

## Intended use / 使用场景

What design or implementation task would this help with?

## Material / 素材

Public source URL, exact file or example, author and pinned revision if available. Explain what is distinct from existing registry entries.

## Reuse and provenance / 复用与来源

What is the proposed status (research-only, prototype, reference implementation)? What is known about licensing, dependencies, and redistribution? Do not upload restricted media or private research.

## Related assets / 已有素材

Relevant stable IDs or catalog search results, if available. No need to invent an ID.
